problem.title: Count Pivot Indices
problem.problemStatement: Given an array of integers, determine the number of pivot indices. A pivot index is an index where the sum of elements to its left equals the sum of elements to its right.
problem.input: • First line contains N. • Second line contains N integers.
problem.output: • Print the number of pivot indices.
